verdict.rationale: The evidence documents user and business account-holder resources and card creation tied to a user, but nothing about KYC or KYB verification. It shows no verification data requirements, review states or re-verification flows. Account-holder objects are an adjacent building block, not identity verification, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an ops user, cardholder verification is built into issuance — KYC for consumers and KYB for businesses run through the platform with documented data requirements, review states, and re-verification flows
